title: Boss SY-1000 Guitar Synthesizer

controlChangeCommands.name: Bank Select
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Bank Select MSB (CC0). LSB (CC32) received as 0. FIX RX PC MAP: 200 patches (U01-1–P50-4) via PROGRAM MAP BANK1–BANK4. CC1-31 and CC64-95 user-assignable via ASSIGN SOURCE; no fixed factory CC map.

additionalInfo: 5-pin DIN MIDI IN and OUT/THRU. SYNC CLOCK must be AUTO/MIDI/USB (not INTERNAL) to receive clock.
